title: Wood-burning mobile sauna.
description:
Driving Sauna offers a unique spa experience delivered to your doorstep. Driving Sauna is a mobile sauna on wheels for up to 8-15 people. Whether you are on a picnic, hiking trip or even in the comfort of your home, our Driving Sauna is the first wood-burning sauna in Tennessee and that can be wherever you are.
Driving Sauna is a safe and positive relaxing space for all to enjoy. Breaking a sweat has lots of health benefits and this is your chance to try and enjoy it.

The space
We bring the sauna to your place

Guest access
Sauna has a hot room and a sitting area
